messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: semidefinite-programming relaxation of pairwise area constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The SDP relaxation of the 286 triangle-area constraints on the 13x13 Gram matrix X (encoding pairwise squared distances, augmented by rank and PSD constraints) attains an optimum of 1/18 ≈ 0.0556, and a feasible 13-point configuration achieving this minimum exists with coordinates drawn from the explicit solution of the dual SDP via a rank-3 decomposition of X. Falsification occurs if either the primal SDP optimum is strictly less than 1/18 or every rank-3 decomposition of the optimal X yields a point set with a minimum triangle area below 1/18."}
